name: Orva

media.caption: An ad generated end to end by Orva.

problem: A professional ad video is expensive and takes weeks. Small brands can't afford it. They fall back on flat visuals while the big players flood social feeds with polished content.
delivered: A full SaaS that turns a simple idea into studio-quality video in minutes. The user describes, picks a style, gets a film. On the brand side, a Studio offer produces tailored ads.

name: Universal IT
tagline: I spotted a market, built the tool, founded the company.
title: I spotted a market, I built the tool, I founded the company.

gallery.caption: The simulator generates a priced quote live, during the client meeting.
Cost-management score and avoided CAPEX, computed automatically.
Five-year savings projection, ready to present to the client.
The public site for the maintenance offer.

problem: Server maintenance contracts from manufacturers (Dell, HPE) rise 8 to 20% per year. Many companies overpay on hardware that's still perfectly reliable, unaware an alternative exists.
delivered: A third-party maintenance offer up to 70% cheaper, at equivalent SLA. And to sell it, a simulator that compares costs and generates a tailored quote live, during the client meeting, instead of two hours of work afterwards.
running: The company is incorporated, the site is live, the quoting tool works and I use it in every meeting. This is the project where I carry everything: the market diagnosis, the product, and the sale.
under: Custom front and back, integrated price catalog, subscription wired to Stripe. Deliberately simple: here the value isn't in the tech, it's in the speed of response to the client.
role: Founder. From the company registration to the first quote, alone.

name: HalluGuard
tagline: Track what AI says about your brand.
title: What AI invents about your brand, under watch.

gallery.caption: The promise: stop the false facts AI spreads about your brand.
Real-time detection, reliability score per LLM, prioritized alerts.
Plans built from solo to agency, payment wired in.

problem: Your customers no longer search only on Google. They ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity. And these AIs sometimes state false things about your brand, with total confidence. You don't see it, they do.
delivered: A tool that monitors what the major models say about your brand, detects inaccuracies and hallucinations, scores the reliability of each AI, and generates an action plan to fix the sources.
running: Fully built SaaS, ready to deploy. Auth, multi-brand dashboards, billing, automated daily scans.
under: Production-grade multi-tenant architecture: Supabase with RLS, multi-model scoring engine, crawling via Firecrawl. A product for a brand-new category: search in the age of generative AI.
role: Design and build from end to end. 107 files.
